description: This Wakayama Prefecture repository publishes a map of welfare evacuation shelters suited to people with mental disabilities, one of a set of shelter maps the prefecture made for different types of disability. The archived copy read on 2026-09-28 through Software Heritage holds the same list in CSV, JSON, KML and Shapefile form, the CSV being about 11 KB, last updated in December 2021, with a README explaining that the prefecture's Information Policy Division runs the account to publish open data and work with engineers on local problems. The exact fields of the shelter list, such as capacity or contact details, were not inspected here. Coverage is Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. The data are free under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence, and the prefecture accepts no liability for their use. Caveats: the files date from 2021, and shelter designations may have changed since. It supports emergency response studies, such as checking whether people with mental disabilities in tsunami inundation zones can reach a suitable welfare shelter. Related record: the Baltimore evacuation shelter layer.
